itemized.notes: TWO CONTRADICTORY ITEMIZATIONS OF THE SAME $5,500 - A HUMAN SHOULD LOOK. The handwritten Schedule A (p3) lists only TWO lines - '1/15/10 | Randy Horiuchi | SLC UT | Candidate | 1,500.00' and '4/8/10 | Studsvik, Inc | Atlanta GA | 4,000.00' - plus the words 'See attached' written in the name column of a lower row; its printed SUBTOTAL is 5500.00. The attached typed spreadsheet (p4, titled 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received') lists SIX lines totalling $5,500.00, in which the p3 Studsvik 4,000.00 line recurs verbatim but the p3 'Randy Horiuchi / Candidate / 1,500.00' line is instead broken into FIVE separate 1/15/2010 donors (silverbullet group inc 250, Cline Michele 250, Johnson Lonnie 500, Davis Scott 250, Suite Steven 250) summing to exactly 1,500.00. The attachment is transcribed here as the itemization (it is the finer grain, it is what 'See attached' points to, and it carries city/state); the p3 handwritten Horiuchi line is NOT emitted, because emitting both would double the side to 11,000 against a stated 5,500. The five 1/15/2010 rows carry needs_review=1 for the donor-identity conflict. Street-address column on the attachment is a solid black COUNTY REDACTION box; city/state/zip printed to the right of it. Filing header on both schedule pages is hand-dated 2/14/13 over a struck-through 'Jan 31 11' date of report; the chunk listing calls this a 2010 Final Amended report.
